claim: On a synthetic pipeline with 50 runs per cell, one-factor-at-a-time interventions attributed a behaviour change to the real cause in 0.825 of replications, blamed an inert co-change in at most 0.025, and attributed both of two simultaneous causes in 0.90.
integrity_note: Integrity is not truth: a verifying manifest shows these files are unchanged since packaging; it does not show the experiment or the claim is correct.
scope: Pre-registered (protocol 30ce32f), master seed 20261011, 200 replications per world, 2 factors. I2 is a narrow pass (Wilson 95% CI 0.77-0.87). Revert-one necessity missed retrieval in about 95% of two-cause replications and is not used for attribution. Synthetic only; real systems with unknown causes remain open. Traces are regenerable from seeds and not included. Single author, not blind.
